## Technologies and Stacks
- Kubernetes
- Linux
- Prometheus & Grafana & Loki & Telegraf & InfluxDB
- Git & GitHub
- Docker
- Helm

I interact daily with open-source 5G cores — **SD-Core (Aether)**, **Free5GC**  and **Open5GS**. There's also a fair bit of commercial 5G Cores such as the **Huawei** and **Cumucore** one. These don't fit neatly in the lists above but are very relevant to my day-to-day work.

## To Be Learned (and/or deepened)
- Ansible 
- Terraform
- Certificates (I do a fair bit of TLS certificate management for via Cloudflare DNS and Lets Encrypt)
- Monitoring (Going deeper on Loki and Telegraf is my main goal)
- Traefik (for cluster networking)
- Podman
- LXC

Also want to become more familiar with cloud platforms like AWS and GCP, though its hard to do it given my access to those tools is very limited :(
